title: AI Proposal Follow-up Assistant
tagline: Recover stalled proposals with timely, relevant follow-ups.
businessOutcomes: More sent proposals get a reply instead of going quiet.
summary: Identifies quotes and proposals that have not received a response and drafts follow-up messages based on proposal details and customer context.
businessProblem: Proposals go out and get forgotten — reps move to new opportunities while sent quotes sit unopened. Studies show most deals need 3+ follow-ups after proposal, but most reps stop after one.
outcome: Automated detection of silent proposals with tiered follow-up drafts referencing specific proposal content, prior conversations, and appropriate urgency — ready for rep send.
expectedOutcomes: Automated detection of silent proposals with tiered follow-up drafts referencing specific proposal content, prior conversations, and appropriate urgency — ready for rep send.
whoItsFor: B2B sellers who send formal quotes or proposals via email or CRM and lose deals to silence rather than explicit rejection.
aiInputs: Proposal sent date, amount, line items, and recipient
Days since send with no response or open signal
Prior email thread context and objections raised
Call notes from discovery and proposal walkthrough
aiOutputs: List of stalled proposals ranked by deal value and silence duration
Follow-up email draft referencing specific proposal sections
Alternative angles: value recap, objection address, deadline, break-up email
CRM task creation payload for rep review
Suggested call script if email unresponsive after 2 touches
noCodeTools: HubSpot deal stages + task reminders with ChatGPT draft paste
Zapier: deal in 'Proposal Sent' 5+ days → GPT follow-up → Gmail draft
lowCodeTools: n8n daily: CRM proposal stage deals → silence check → Claude draft → Gmail
Google Sheets proposal tracker + Apps Script + OpenAI
Make.com: proposal tool webhook → follow-up schedule → email draft
customBuildStack: CRM query for deals in proposal-sent stage beyond threshold
Gmail thread search for proposal attachment and reply detection
OpenAI/Claude with proposal context and objection-aware prompts
Recovery metrics: proposal-to-close rate before and after automation
implementationSteps: Define proposal-sent stage in CRM and required fields (amount, sent date)
Set follow-up cadence rules: 3, 7, 14 days with different message angles
Connect Gmail to detect replies — exclude deals with recent responses
Build prompts that reference proposal line items and prior objections
Deliver as morning Gmail drafts or CRM tasks for rep approval
Track recovery rate and adjust cadence based on industry sales cycle
systemBehavior: Runs daily scan of proposal-stage deals — not instant on send
Draft-only — rep reviews and sends every follow-up
Stops cadence on reply, meeting booked, or explicit opt-out
Escalates high-value silent proposals to manager after 14 days
Never discounts or changes proposal terms without rep input
risks: Aggressive follow-up on proposals annoys buyers and damages relationships
Misdetecting replies in CC'd threads creates duplicate follow-ups
Break-up emails can prematurely kill deals still in internal review
Proposal content in AI prompts may include confidential pricing
